executive_summary: Test direct code-to-Parquet writing on four selected public workloads, retaining exact bytes and every timing sample.

rationale.t3-gb-mega-throughput: Large journals expose repeated string expansion and Parquet finalization cost.
rationale.t3-gb-pop-horizon-scale: Population and horizon growth test sustained message output volume.
rationale.t3-mr-deep-book-state-size: A substantial state workload tests whether output savings remain visible when simulation cost is large.
rationale.t3-s001-price-time-priority: Small deterministic matching workload checks fixed writer overhead and possible regressions.
rationale.t3-gbatch-hetero-mix: Heterogeneous batch correctness control checks independent market schemas, nulls and vocabulary usage; excluded from timing.

timing.secondary: core, finalization, write and hash phases

correctness.shared_developer_gates: unchanged repository checker imported by coordinator
